subject: Request: Extend authorization window + evidence to prevent chargeback for AlphaTech invoice
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@alphatech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@alphatech.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Failed payment on invoice #4892 — can we pause collection?

Hi Sean,

We just saw a failed authorization for invoice #4892 (for May usage). Our finance team caught the Stripe decline (issuer 3DS required) and wants to avoid a chargeback while we sort internal approval.

Can Redwood pause any automatic retries or collections for 48 hours and extend the authorization window so our card processor can re-attempt with the updated 3DS flow? We will also provide a corrected VAT reference — the invoice shows our old VAT ID.

Also please advise what evidence Redwood can supply to preempt a potential dispute if the bank flags it.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Finance Manager, AlphaTech
T: +1 415-555-0179

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@alphatech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed payment on invoice #4892 — can we pause collection?

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick heads up.

Short answers up front: yes, we can pause automated collection attempts and request an extended authorization window from Stripe/acquirer; and yes, we can supply pre-canned evidence to minimize dispute risk (service delivery records, signed SOW reference, invoice PDF with VAT correction).

Next steps I propose:
- I will hold scheduled retries for 48 hours and open an authorization extension request with our PSP to allow an extra retry window.
- If you can send the corrected VAT ID and a contact at your bank, we will include that in our evidence package.
- Laura, please attach the invoice PDF (with updated VAT field) and the dunning log for the transaction so I can forward to the acquirer/Stripe.

Alice — can you confirm the VAT ID and whether you prefer we send a secure card-update link to the finance inbox, or you will use your billing portal? If we send a link we can capture a tokenized card quickly and avoid issuer-side 3DS friction.

I’m including a short list of the evidence we can provide:
- invoice_4892_20270531.pdf (signed billing summary)
- logs showing tokenization attempt and timestamped usage records (per-customer request history)
- copy of the SOW and PO referenced in the invoice

I’ll hold on retries and update you when I have a response from Stripe.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0124

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed payment on invoice #4892 — can we pause collection?

Sean — attaching the files you requested.

Attachments: invoice_4892_20270531.pdf (PDF), dunning_log_4892.csv (CSV)

I also exported the per-request usage report and proof-of-delivery timestamps; those are available if AlphaTech wants granular logs.

FYI — I put a manual hold on the scheduled retry in our billing system, so we won’t attempt any automated capture until we hear back from the PSP or you clear the hold.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@alphatech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, finance@alphatech.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Failed payment on invoice #4892 — authorization window extended; evidence package sent to acquirer

Alice / AlphaTech finance team — quick update:

- I requested an authorization-window extension with our PSP (ticket #PSP-87133). They’ve approved a 72-hour extension to allow your issuer to perform an additional 3DS flow.
- I sent an evidence bundle to the acquirer that includes the corrected invoice (attached), timestamped usage logs, and the signed SOW. The acquirer acknowledged receipt and said they will flag the transaction as "in dispute mediation" rather than auto-chargeback for now.
- We will not resume auto-retries; we can initiate a secure card-update link if you’d like us to create a fresh token instead. That link will be single-use and expire after 24 hours.

If AlphaTech confirms the corrected VAT ID in reply, Laura will re-issue the invoice PDF with the updated tax reference and I’ll append it to the acquirer evidence.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on this — we’ll keep monitoring and I’ll escalate to payments if we see anything change.

Best,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
